title: Maintaining Proper Drain Pipe Slope and Alignment
description: Proper pipe slope is essential for effective gravity drainage. If a horizontal drain pipe has insufficient pitch, water flows too slowly, allowing suspended solids to settle and form blockages over time. Conversely, excessive slope can cause liquids to drain rapidly while leaving solid waste behind. Verifying continuous slope using a spirit level during routine maintenance prevents low spots or bellies. Supporting long runs with properly spaced pipe hangers keeps wastewater moving reliably according to regional plumbing codes.
caption:
Maintaining Proper Drain Pipe Slope and Alignment

Proper pipe slope is essential for effective gravity drainage. If a horizontal drain pipe has insufficient pitch, water flows too slowly, allowing suspended solids to settle and form blockages over time. Conversely, excessive slope can cause liquids to drain rapidly while leaving solid waste behind. Verifying continuous slope using a spirit level during routine maintenance prevents low spots or bellies. Supporting long runs with properly spaced pipe hangers keeps wastewater moving reliably according to regional plumbing codes.
